summary: The figure illustrates the spatial distribution of various biological components over time, including epithelial cells, immune cells, virus, Type I IFN, chemokines, and IL-10. Observations are made at different time points: 1, 2, 3, 4, 7, and 14 days. The study suggests that spatially resolved models can better predict infection dynamics. Differential adhesion and chemotaxis parameters were qualitatively formulated to align with ODE model results.
